title: THE BEAST / 第一次交战
game_trigger: Piloted original Unit-01, nearby grounded Sachiel at or below 32% health, a clear street encounter space

stages.name: control_loss
stages.intent: Recover weight and establish autonomous Unit-01 control

stages.name: field_press
stages.intent: Both palms contact the field with planted feet

stages.name: field_tear
stages.intent: Open the field from the centre with widening arm and torso effort

stages.name: counter_burst
stages.intent: Sachiel's close-range counterflash fails to stop Unit-01

stages.name: arm_grip
stages.intent: Match both EVA hands to the Angel's wrists

stages.name: arm_break
stages.intent: A short sharp release of tension, followed by limp arms

stages.name: kick
stages.intent: A supported kick drives Sachiel backwards into a fall

stages.name: pounce
stages.intent: Leap onto the downed Angel with a fast weighted landing

stages.name: core_punches
stages.intent: Two distinct core strikes with bracing, acceleration and recovery

stages.name: rib_strike
stages.intent: An original detached rib prop follows the right-hand socket into the core

stages.name: angel_wrap
stages.intent: Sachiel curls around the upper body of Unit-01

stages.name: self_destruct
stages.intent: Cross-shaped final flash, actor death and reward exactly once

stages.name: return_control
stages.intent: Blend to the player's previous camera and return control

acceptance: Animation, roots, cameras, contacts and sound cues share one timeline
No replacement or duplicate canonical EVA is spawned
The actual pilot remains mounted and protected during the directed sequence
Skip, reload, disconnect and missing-actor paths restore control and physics
Cinematic effects do not force destructive edits into the authored city
Ordinary combat remains playable and does not run this choreography repeatedly
